headline: Big Balder Brand: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Big Balder Brand is projected #2 of 16 with a 708.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Trey McBride, Rashee Rice, and A.J. Brown. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Sum of every verified rostered player's D-AVI value from all 16 AVI-Core team files

latest_trade.summary: On July 24, Big Balder Brand traded with DMV Fantasy and acquired Cam Little, Saquon Barkley while sending Breece Hall. Cam Little is now on the current roster; Saquon Barkley is now the current RB starter at 91.7 C-AVI and 86.0 D-AVI.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Chris Godwin's 61.7 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 75.0 C-AVI would directly attack the 13.30-point projected gap to Conquistadors.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.

latest_trade.summary: On October 29, Mile High Royal Lions traded with TacticsNoob and acquired Marvin Harrison while sending Rachaad White, 2026 Round 2 (Conquistadors), 2027 Round 1 (Big Balder Brand). Marvin Harrison is now the current FLEX starter at 72.4 C-AVI and 78.6 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility.
